title: Robust Tournaments
abstract: arXiv:2507.16348v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We characterize robust tournament design---the prize scheme that maximizes the lowest equilibrium effort in a rank-order tournament where the distribution of noise is unknown, except for an upper bound, $\bar{H}$, on its Shannon entropy. The robust tournament awards positive prizes to all ranks except the last, with a distinct top prize. Robust prizes spread marginal incentives as evenly as possible across performance quantiles, minimizing the Kullback--Leibler divergence from the uniform distribution to the induced distribution of performance cutoffs. Asymptotically, robust prizes follow the harmonic number sequence, while the worst-case distribution of noise converges to an exponential distribution with rate $e^{1-\bar{H}}$. The prize scheme is highly unequal, especially in small tournaments, but becomes more equitable as the number of agents grows, with the Gini coefficient approaching $1/2$. translated_abstract: 我们刻画了鲁棒锦标赛设计——即在排名次序锦标赛中，当噪声分布未知、仅知其香农熵存在上界 $\bar{H}$ 时，能够最大化最低均衡努力水平的奖金方案。鲁棒锦标赛对除最后一名以外的所有名次均发放正奖金，并设有独特的最高奖金。鲁棒奖金尽可能均匀地在业绩分位数之间分布边际激励，使均匀分布与所诱导的业绩临界值分布之间的库尔贝克–莱布勒（KL）散度最小化。在渐近意义上，鲁棒奖金遵循调和数序列，而最坏情况下的噪声分布收敛于速率为 $e^{1-\bar{H}}$ 的指数分布。该奖金方案高度不平等，在小规模锦标赛中尤甚，但随着参与者数量的增加而变得更为公平，其基尼系数趋近于 $1/2$。在大锦标赛模型中，对数…
tldr: 本文刻画了在噪声分布未知（仅知香农熵上界）的排名锦标赛中最大化最低均衡努力水平的鲁棒奖金设计：除最后一名外所有名次均获得正奖金且渐近遵循调和数序列，该方案虽然高度不平等，但随参赛者人数增加而趋于公平（基尼系数趋近1/2）。
en_tdlr: The paper characterizes the robust prize scheme that maximizes the lowest equilibrium effort in rank-order tournaments with unknown noise distribution bounded by Shannon entropy, showing that it awards positive prizes to all but the last rank, follows the harmonic number sequence asymptotically, and is highly unequal yet becomes more equitable as the number of agents grows.
